response.rationale: Brugada syndrome can present with conduction block and ST elevation, though typical location is right precordial; here inferior ST elevation and AV block are more specific than CPVT or LQTS, which lack these ECG findings. Genetic testing negative does not exclude all variants.

rejected.why: No QT prolongation or torsades; ECG shows AV block and ST elevation, not LQTS pattern.
CPVT typically shows polymorphic VT with exercise, not AV block or inferior ST elevation; no such ECG evidence.
